webster.text: Entire loss or ruin; utter destruction; as the perdition of the Turkish fleet.

example.quote: Our state vessel has sprung a leak ; we must embark in a new bottom, or sink into perdition.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
